description: Staging network (AUT-101), owner decisions N1-N8 of docs/implementation/staging/AUT-101-design-package.md, planned by infra/terraform/envs/staging-core. Changed only through a reviewed pull request.
decision: 2026-10-05: N1 egress model A (public subnet, no inbound access, outbound-only Cloudflare tunnel); N2 host t4g.small; N3 budget stays 25 USD; N4-N8 the recommended defaults. Review 2026-10-05: the S3 endpoint also allows the SSM buckets (agent updates, document modules, Distributor); Patch Manager is not used (host patching by dnf, AUT-108); az_id is pinned once the first plan shows the chosen AZ. C3 (2026-10-05): flow logs go to the logs bucket (vpc-flow/, 30 days, staging-platform.json storage.logs_flow_expire_days); no role is passed. Scanner implementation 2026-10-12 (engineering, no owner decision changed): az_id pinned to aps1-az1, the AZ ID of the existing host subnet (ap-south-1a) read from the state embedded in the plan artifact core-plan-38160993150 (10-infra-plan run 38160993150 on main at commit 246ffeeddf2b9612c6a55be9aa34ce1366c2f5a6, state serial 14, no changes). The pin is the prerequisite of any instance-type change (phase-1 record §4.4): the offering check now evaluates that AZ only and the subnet can never be proposed for replacement. host_instance_type changes only with AD-2.
